name: Perlemian Trade Route
summary: The oldest of the great hyperlanes, running from Coruscant north-east past Brentaal and Taanab to Ossus and the far Rim at Quermia. It and the Corellian Run frame the Slice, the Republic's ancient heartland. Waypoints here are approximate.

name: Corellian Run
summary: The second great route, blazed by Corellian scouts from Coruscant through Corellia and Denon south-east to the Outer Rim near Ryloth. Waypoints shown are a simplified selection.

name: Corellian Trade Spine
summary: A route branching from Corellia and Duro down the galaxy's western side through Yag'Dhul and the Anoat sector toward Terminus. The Bespin leg follows the Ison Corridor branch; waypoints are approximate.

name: Rimma Trade Route
summary: The southern artery from Abregado-rae in the Core through Thyferra and Yag'Dhul down to Sullust, Eriadu and Sluis Van. Waypoints shown are a simplified selection.

name: Hydian Way
summary: The newest and longest of the five great routes, crossing the whole galaxy from Bonadan in the north-east through Telos, Brentaal and Denon to Eriadu in the south. Waypoints shown are a simplified selection.
